subject: a friendly medium-sized brown dog with a red collar
style: clean 2D game sprite, side view, consistent proportions and camera
background: plain white background inside every frame

actions.name: Idle
actions.description: The dog remains in place with a subtle breathing loop.

frames.description: Chest rises slightly while the head stays steady.
Chest reaches the top of the breathing motion.
Chest settles back toward the neutral pose.

actions.name: Walk
actions.description: A seamless side-view walking cycle moving in place.

frames.description: Front-left leg reaches forward; rear-right leg pushes back.
Body passes over the planted legs; paws near the body center.
Front-right leg reaches forward; rear-left leg pushes back.
Opposite passing pose; body returns toward the first contact.

actions.name: Sit
actions.description: The dog transitions from standing to a seated pose and holds it.

frames.description: Hindquarters lower halfway while front legs remain planted.
Hindquarters nearly touch the ground; torso becomes upright.
Fully seated pose, stable and relaxed.
